title: Edit this passage without changing the tone
steps: read the passage and its surrounding paragraph, not just the sentence to change
locate every occurrence of the exact text to change; if there is more than one, disambiguate before editing (never apply to the first match blindly)
apply the edit, matching the passage's existing voice, register and punctuation style
read the edited passage back in context and confirm nothing around it now reads inconsistently
success_conditions: only the named passage changed — nothing else in the document did
the edited text reads as the same voice as the rest of the document
